decisions.reason: The LED part and supply-voltage decision does not change USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or availability requirements.
The source selects an LED part and operating voltage but does not change the interboard connector partition, connector types, signals, or pin-order policy.
The existing AXP2101 requirement already covers all system loads in normal operation, so the LED voltage decision does not alter its current state.
The current 5V-boost load list already excludes the LEDs; confirming that the selected LEDs use 3.3V leaves the boost-control requirement unchanged.
The LED part and voltage selection does not affect native USB data lines, enumeration, or flashing behavior.
The source does not resolve or change the battery connector family, part number, pin functions, or disputed pin order.
Selecting a 3.3V LED part does not change battery protection, cutoff voltages, or protection-component requirements.
The source selects an LED part and voltage but does not change the task-local BOM completeness, sourcing, or component-justification requirements.
